Definition: of Latin origin; growing; Cresces (i.e. Crescens), a Christian:--Crescens.
BiblicalUsage: Crescens appears once, in Paul's last letter, in the list of those who had left him: "Demas hath forsaken me... Crescens to Galatia, Titus unto Dalmatia" in 2 Timothy 4:10. Unlike Demas, no reason is given for his going, and nothing in the text blames him for it.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is simply that Crescens is a reminder that not every departure is a desertion: Paul names him plainly, without a word against him, and I take that silence as respect.
